tools.name: change_discover
tools.description: Discover the currently published dynamic facility-operation capability for one released synchrotron machine-study action. Returns its opaque operation name, generation, lifecycle state, and required next action. A release key from the user is required; rediscover only when a direct lifecycle result requires it.

tools.name: change_act
tools.description: Apply one lifecycle action to an already discovered synchrotron facility operation. Always pass the exact item, operation_tool, and generation returned by discovery. Use action authorize with no credential; execute with the returned authorization credential; submit with the successful execution proof and exact execution value; status after submission to confirm closure. Direct errors state whether rediscovery or reauthorization is required.
